title: Tenant Pack Manifest
description: Validates tenant.json at the root of a tenant pack repo (ADR-034 §3). Consumed by install.sh --pack (landing + compose), /project-init (tenant assembly), and the provisioner. Normative documentation + pack-repo CI; runtime checks are jq-based (no schema-validator dependency).

tenant_id.description: Stable tenant slug. Names the landing dir ~/.claude/packs/<tenant_id>/; written into project stack-config.json by /project-init; keys reconciler PRs.

pack_version.description: Semver of this pack's content. Stamped into .pack-install.json and stack-defaults.json tenant_pack; keys reconciler PR delivery (ADR-034 §5).

display_name.description: Human-readable tenant name for banners and provisioner output.

github.description: GitHub settings the provisioner uses when creating tenant repos.

org.description: GitHub org new tenant repos are created under.

merge_policy.description: Merge method the provisioner configures on new repos' branch protection.

database.description: Tenant database defaults, consumed by /database-design and the provisioner.

default.description: Default database provider for new tenant projects.

supabase_conditions.description: Prose: conditions under which Supabase applies instead of the default. Surfaced in the /database-design decision prompt.

clerk.description: Tenant Clerk auth settings, consumed by the provisioner and /clerk-auth.

publishable_key.description: Clerk publishable key (publishable — allowed in a pack; secret keys are NEVER pack content, ADR-035).

org_id.description: Clerk organization id the provisioner wires new apps to.

deploy.description: Tenant deploy defaults, consumed by the provisioner.

default.description: Deploy target. Single-value enum on purpose — widen when a second target exists.

cloudflare.description: Cloudflare deploy settings consumed by secret-binder (ADR-035). The Secrets Store id is deliberately NOT a field here — account id and store id are distinct 32-hex values, and the store id is always resolved live via the list-stores API.

account_id.description: Tenant's Cloudflare account id (NOT the Secrets Store id).

api_token_keychain_item.description: macOS Keychain item name holding the tenant API token — secret-binder's local fallback when <TENANT>_API_TOKEN is not in env. Names an item, never a value.

engine_url.description: Tenant recommend-capabilities engine endpoint, consumed by engine hooks.

design_tokens_path.description: Pack-relative path to the tenant design tokens, consumed by /screenshot-diff, UI skills, and /project-init vendoring.

standards.description: Map of standard name to pack-relative path. NOT installed globally — /project-init vendors these into each repo as committed files (ADR-034 §4).

ci_templates.description: Map of template name to {source, dest}: source is a pack-relative CI template file, dest is its destination path in the consuming project (e.g. .github/workflows/run_tests.yml). NOT installed globally — /project-init vendors these into each repo as committed files, the same delivery mechanism as `standards` (ADR-034 §4), except the destination is pack-declared rather than reusing the source's own relative path (a pack's CI template rarely lives at the same relative path it is delivered to).

source.description: Pack-relative path to the CI template file, e.g. templates/run_tests.yml.

dest.description: Repo-relative destination path in the consuming project, e.g. .github/workflows/run_tests.yml.

claude_fragment_path.description: Pack-relative path to the org CLAUDE.md fragment. pack-installer applies it to the global CLAUDE.md ORG_OVERLAY_MANAGED region; /project-init uses it for project CLAUDE.md assembly.

gemini_generator.description: Toggles the Gemini-powered generator skill for this tenant.

secrets.description: Secret NAMES only, never values (ADR-034, ADR-035 §5). Provisioner resolves each name to a Cloudflare Secrets Store id and emits wrangler bindings.

account_model.description: Provisioning design v2 §1.1/§11 decision 1: whether this tenant's /provision-created resources are billed and owned by the tenant org, or by the end user. Generic field -- no default here, so no tenant's value is assumed for another. Only org-owned is implemented by the provisioner today; a pack declaring user-owned means assisted-mode write phases refuse until that path is built.

escalation.description: Provisioning design v2 §3: the escalation path /provision assisted mode uses for any refusal, capability gap, or mid-run failure. A tenant pack must declare this for assisted mode to be available at all (assisted mode refuses to run write phases without it, §1.2).

channel.description: Escalation channel. Only github-issue is implemented (§11 decision 2). Deliberately an enum of one today rather than a free string, so a second channel (e.g. a Slack/email webhook, §11 decision 2 option b) is added by widening this enum -- no reshape of the object needed.

repo.description: org/repo of the ops-queue repo escalation issues are filed against. Required when channel is github-issue.

assignees.description: GitHub handles of operators the escalation issue is assigned to.

fallback_contact.description: Plain-words human fallback shown to the colleague when the channel itself can't be reached (§3.1 step 5) -- e.g. the issue can't be filed. Still zero technical action required of the colleague.

name.description: Plain name of the fallback human contact.

how.description: Plain words for how to reach them, e.g. 'email' or 'phone' -- never a technical URL or command.

provenance.description: Provisioning design v2 §6 fix 4: pack provenance pinning. Declares the canonical private git source this pack must be installed from. This is a self-declared, install-time CONSISTENCY check, not a security boundary on its own -- a compromised pack repo is upstream of it (§10.4 residual); the real boundary is pack-repo access control. The installer (scripts/lib/project-pack-vendor.sh / pack-installer.sh) compares the source it actually fetched from against this pin and refuses a mismatch; that comparison logic is a later build phase, not part of this schema addition. Commit-SHA pinning deliberately lives on the INSTALL RECORD side (already captured as tenant_pack.sha in the composed stack-defaults.json, per pack-installer.sh's compose step), not here -- a pack cannot declare its own future commit.

source_url.description: Canonical (pinned) private git source this pack must be installed from, e.g. git@github.com:<org>/<pack-repo>.git. A pack whose recorded install source does not match this value is refused.

pinned_ref.description: Optional pinned git ref (branch or tag) the pack is expected to track. Absent means any ref off source_url is accepted.
